hero.subtitle: ChatGPT can't watch videos — but it can read them. Connect TranscriptX, paste a YouTube link, and ChatGPT gets the full transcript to summarize, translate or answer questions about. Works with TikTok, Instagram, X and video files too.

quickAnswer.question: Can ChatGPT watch YouTube videos?
quickAnswer.answer: Not by itself, but it can with TranscriptX. Connect TranscriptX to ChatGPT, paste a YouTube link and ask ChatGPT to transcribe or summarize it. TranscriptX turns the video into text and hands the full transcript to ChatGPT, which can then summarize the video or answer questions about it.

sections.h2: How ChatGPT Summarizes YouTube Videos With TranscriptX
content: ChatGPT reads text, not video. When you paste a YouTube link on its own, it cannot hear what is said in the video, so any summary is a guess.
TranscriptX solves that. It transcribes everything spoken in the video and returns the full text to ChatGPT. From there, ChatGPT summarizes the real content — not just the title and description.

Transcribe videos in 100+ languages, then ask ChatGPT to translate the summary.
